title: The second volume and its cover portrait
summary: He describes Volume 2, its cover portrait and plans for Volume 3.

bands.name: Big Chief Moore's Pow Wow Jazz Band

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Well, Phil Stein was a great artist and I brought the frame from him, the gold frame that's here and I don't know if the frame is on the album -- is it on the album cover or is it just --
Oh, yes, I see. You can see it in my house here.
You got a lovely photo, lovely portrait.
That's where he gets the pen name, or rather the Estaño.
And he did the drawing for the second cover,
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Yes, Volume No. 2, the picture on No. 2 is the way I look now with my gray hair and the Navajo shirt, the Navajo necklace and this portrait was copied off of a photo that the wife of the trombone player -- Herb Gardner's wife was out of New City -- who was a trombone player.
I see. New City is not far from here?
No, no. His wife is a great photographer. She took that picture and I gave it to Estaño and he copied it for the album. Volume No. 2 has my picture, my portrait on the album.
Phil suggested that this time we're going to have a real studio and some great guys who are going to record, so I'm looking forward to Volume No. 3, I haven't recorded it yet.
